name: Raw Evidence Record Schema
description: Schema for storing raw evidence snapshots before any interpretation

id.description: Unique identifier for this raw evidence record (e.g., raw_ev_001)

sourceName.description: Name of the source (from source registry)

sourceClass.description: Class of the source (public-founder-proof, competitor-pricing, etc.)

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the content was fetched

collector.description: Name of the collector that fetched this content

contentType.description: MIME type of the content (text/html, text/plain, application/json)

httpStatus.description: HTTP status code returned by the fetch

rawTextPath.description: Path to the file containing the raw text content

entityHint.description: Hint about which candidate entity this evidence relates to

notes.description: Notes about why this evidence was collected

supports.description: List of decision dimensions this evidence supports
